'''Lynden Pater''' (forums handle '''ideatrack''') is a volunteer of the [[Players Committee]]. The Players Committee organization chart of 6 May 2024 lists Lynden Pater as a member of the Proofing team, under the [[Design Advocate]] [[Chris Kelly]].<ref name="chart">PC Organization Chart, [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback Machine capture of 10 October 2026] of [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (PDF creation date 6 May 2024).</ref> See [[Players Committee organization]].
